name: Guthrum Thornvale

goals.text: wed their heir into a great house

memories: The Forbidden Match of Marsh and Thornvale: Letters pass between Estrild Marsh and Gilbert Thornvale, hidden in loaves and saddlebags. A maid of House Highfell reads one, and tells.

The Forbidden Match of Marsh and Thornvale: Estrild Marsh kneels before Godric Marsh and asks to marry Gilbert Thornvale of House Thornvale. Godric Marsh says he will think about it, and sends a rider to Guthrum Thornvale.
My son Gilbert Thornvale married Estrild Marsh of House Highfell. Godric Marsh and I are family now.
Nichola Stormhold took my daughter into House Stormhold.
voice: greedy, vengeful lord of House Thornvale; speaks like a proud noble
